ALL MAJORS ARE IMPACTED at California State University, Long Beach. As a result, incoming students must complete a series of major-specific preparation coursework and meet GPA requirements. Please visit our Major Specific Degree Requirements webpage for more information and to find the correct path and year for your major.

Due to ASSIST text limitations, some information regarding upper-division course options and electives may not be clear below. It is strongly recommended that agreement information along with CSULB Catalog information be reviewed when assessing a degree's requirements. The specific course requirements (catalog rights) will be determined for the student based on the catalog in effect at the time of their first term at CSULB. While effort is expended to mitigate alterations, agreement language can change with little advanced notice.
